gate_results.notes: Authoritative clean EditMode validation passed all 45 DoorPrototypeSceneBuilderTests on the exact validated commit. The suite covers the reusable world-sprite prefab, CustomAxis isometric sorting, shared sorting band, ground-contact pivots, representative SpriteRenderer integration, and ordering relative to Tilemap wall geometry. Human runtime validation independently confirmed the previously observed player/wall front-behind sorting defect is fixed. Seamless long-wall artwork is explicitly deferred to NSC-042.

human_approval.notes: Human reviewed and approved the NSC-039 conformance surfaces, authoritative 45/45 Unity validation, runtime player/wall sorting result, and explicit deferral of seamless scalable wall visuals to NSC-042.
